body_html:
Classmates dead
I could have been one
wrote instead
an exercise of
   freedom
like a muscle it
grows strong
still thy self
in waiting
   language speaks
before an utterance
   perception calls
imagination to
   attention
#smallpoems
#foolingwithwords
Found poem from Lorna Dee Cervantes
